headline: Sri Lanka rupee at 332.75/85 to US dollar spot, bond yields spike
summary: The Sri Lankan rupee was quoted at 332.75/85 to the US dollar in spot trade. Bond yields were quoted higher after the central bank raised its monetary policy rate by 25 basis points.
why: The rupee's exchange rate and government bond yields reflect how investors price Sri Lanka's inflation and monetary policy. Both feed into the cost of government and corporate borrowing.
why_moved: Bond yields rose after the central bank raised its policy rate by 25 basis points.
